title: Exploring the Structure of Anisotropic Random Fields on the Sphere
summary: This paper addresses fundamental questions about the existence and structure of isotropic and anisotropic spherical random fields and the properties of composite transformations of isotropic fields. It introduces a hierarchical structure comprising several classes of anisotropic random fields, using geometric and spectral approaches, and provides a geometric--spectral classification of second-order anisotropy on $\mathbb{S}^2$.
